description: The first UH-1H; a training airframe right beside Prefectural Route 558 at 35.0342N 135.8661E and viewable from the pavement
At 35.0363N 135.8673E; formerly displayed at Tsuiki in a special scheme with a black fin and moved here by the 2007 camp festival

The last JASDF F-86D; at 35.0363N 135.8673E after being moved from 35.0372N 135.8686E when the F-1 arrived; the nose and wing leading edges have been painted yellow since at least 1980; one of only two F-86Ds at JGSDF camps
Recorded among the Otsu airframes; no location detail given
